evidence: Modifies RPC utility helpers (PushWarnings deduplication in src/rpc/util.cpp) and exposes descriptor warnings in getdescriptorinfo (src/rpc/output_script.cpp).
rationale: Exposes missing descriptor warnings in getdescriptorinfo and fixes duplicate warning emissions via PushWarnings. While helpful for tooling catching unsafe Miniscript or cloned multipath expressions, these are warning diagnostic additions rather than high-severity interface bugs.
